biotools.summary: EMImR is a Shiny application designed to identify and correlate differential changes across transcriptomics and epigenomics. It allows users to analyze differentially expressed genes, differentially methylated genes, and interfering microRNAs associated with genetic pathologies.
biotools.name: EMImR: Shiny application for identifying transcriptomic and epigenomic changes
